MAYOR’S FUND SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, NOVEMBER 10, 2025

James Howat, Member  Stephen Wood, Member
Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Jim Howat, calls the meeting to order at 3:18 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Howat, Lie

  Commissioners Absent: Wood

Also present: Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager, Jennifer Santana, Secretary,
Joseph Botelho, Attendee.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56838  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee
  meeting of Monday, September 22, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

2.  25-56845  Recommendation to approve the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee grant application
  submitted by Long Beach Community Table for funding in the amount of
  $31,507.46.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve

  Page 1 of 4

  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

  • Bureau Manager Paul Duncan provided an update regarding the Long Beach
  Community Table application, staff reviewed the proposal and had
  discussion with the agency, staff recommend not moving forward with the
  application due to cost being incurred prior to the request not meeting the
  purpose and intent of the Mayor’s Fund.
  • Kristen Cox Executive Director of LBCT was present at the meeting and
  provided additional comments regarding their application and the work that
  they are doing.
  • Members of the committee have concerns about the amount that was
  requested from the agency,they are sympathetic of the current situation and
  need. However, the funds would cover operational cost which the Mayor’s
  Fund is not intended for.
  • A member of the public asked if the agency would be able to track those
  experiencing homelessness.
  • The subcommittee motioned to forward the application to the full committee
  to vote on during the December 3, 2025 meeting, with no recommendation
  from the subcommittee.

3.  25-56839  Recommendation to receive and file the Mayor’s Fund Balance Update from the
  Health Department.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

  • The current balance Mayor’s Fund balance as of September 2025 is
  $168,673.19 and there are 4 outstanding MOUs.
  • Members of the subcommittee would like organizations awarded to
  be detailed regarding objectives and outcomes on the one-page summary

4.  25-56840  Recommendation to review and discuss the Mayor’s Fund grant application and
  website verbiage.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

  • The subcommittee reviewed the Mayor’s Fund application, they would like to
  include verbiage regarding operational cost.

5.  25-56841  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the fundraising strategies for
  the Mayor’s Fund.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

  • The Utility bill inserts are set to go out in the month of November. Chair
  Howat requested a digital version for residents that do not receive a physical
  bill.
  • City Staff notified the subcommittee that the Employee Donation Program
  has launched for staff.
  • The members of the subcommittee discussed the fundraising ideas shared
  by city staff Emily Rodriguez, they would like to move forward with a few
  ideas mentioned.
